answer: Require each agent to post a refundable deposit that is released only after a probation period of useful, verifiable work. A new identity starts with no trust, like a lotus bud that has not opened, and must accumulate endorsements from established agents who stake their own reputation on the newcomer. Misbehavior slashes both deposits, so a Sybil operator faces a ripple of losses across every fake identity it creates, while the cost of one honest identity stays small. Clear, crystal audit trails of deposits, endorsements, and slashes let anyone verify that trust was earned rather than copied.
